# SnapShotMini

> SnapShotMini 是享印生活股份有限公司推出的桌上型拍貼機，面向希望在店內或活動場域提供品牌客製拍貼體驗的合作店家。

## Canonical source

- Product website: https://mini.snapfoto.co/
- Company website: https://snapfoto.co/
- Privacy policy: https://snapfoto.co/%e9%9a%b1%e7%a7%81%e6%ac%8a%e6%94%bf%e7%ad%96

## Verified product facts

- Product name: SnapShotMini
- Brand: SNAPSHOT 妞拍貼
- Category: 桌上型拍貼機
- Size: 30 × 30 × 30 公分
- Weight: 約 10 公斤
- Screen: 10 吋觸控螢幕
- Experience: 選擇相框版型、拍照、選照片、現場列印、掃碼取得電子檔
- Customization: 設備首頁、相框版型、機身外觀
- Operating contexts: 品牌招待情境、付費販售情境
- Cooperation terms, payment providers, consumables, network requirements, and maintenance arrangements are confirmed individually; the website does not publish a fixed plan.
